skill_description: 弃置两张求生者游戏牌，然后从游戏牌堆抓取一张牌
window_prompt: "制衡": 选择两张求生者游戏牌
content:
var cards = event["cards"]
actions.discard(player, cards)
actions.draw(player, 1)

skill_description: 选择一张拾荒牌和同地图块内另一玩家，将该拾荒牌向该玩家展示，其可以选择一张拾荒牌与你交易
filter_target: return target != player and target.has_method("get_cards") and target.is_player() and target.is_alive() and target.get_cards("", "", 0, "scavenge").size() > 0
filter: return player.get_effective_phase() == "action" and player.get_cards("", "", 0, "scavenge").size() > 0 and player.get_current_block() != null and player.get_current_block().get_players().size() > 1
content:
if not actions.trade_scavenge(player, target, event["cards"][0]):
	EventSystem.cancel(event)
